name: lsa-ppl-off-win
description: Practice-box helper (Windows): turns OFF LSA Protection by setting HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa\RunAsPPL to 0 -- with PPL off, LSASS is readable by any admin-level process and credential dumpers (mimikatz) work unimpeded. The hardened state is RunAsPPL=1. Vars: none. Pairs with a powershell_json check over the same value. Idempotent.
